$description: The default film identity: neutral and fully specified, so a scaffolded film renders before any brand work and any key a brand leaves out has a sound value. A brand film writes its own brand-tokens.json over it (references/brand-system.md); `npm run tokens` merges the two and lists every key it inherited from here.

brand.name: Default
sources: brand-film default identity (neutral; replace with the brand's own sources)

logo.rule: Use the brand's supplied files. Never redraw, recolour or crop a mark; no logo means the brand name set in the headline face. The default files are a neutral placeholder mark.

signature.openingCard: Stage (ink) ground, a two-line headline in the headline face at openingLine size, one accent word (accent-on-stage). Complete from frame 0.
signature.sceneLabel: Numbered mono label, '01 · where we started', in stage-muted with the number in accent-on-stage.
signature.sceneTitle: One line at sceneTitle size; at most one accent word or phrase.
signature.proof: Pictures first. A command card or screenshot may appear, small, as evidence; anything shown as output is real output.
signature.endCard: Card (paper) ground: one line at endCardLine size, one sentence, the page URL.

narrator.voiceName: Christopher - Smooth, calm and very English
narrator.source: ElevenLabs Voice Library (add it to your account, or pick your own with npm run audition)
